description: Office buildings must maintain a Water Use Intensity (WUI) of less than 0.9 cubic meters per square meter per year.
actionable_recommendation: Install WELS 3-tick rated low-flow faucets (<=2.0 L/min) and dual-flush toilets (<=4.0/3.0 L/flush).

description: Sub-meters must be installed for all major water uses (cooling towers, irrigation, tenant spaces) accounting for at least 90% of total consumption.
actionable_recommendation: Install digital IoT pulsed water sub-meters on cooling tower make-up lines and landscape irrigation manifolds.

description: Chilled water usage for cooling systems must not exceed 20% of the building's total general water consumption, and cycles of concentration must be >= 6.
actionable_recommendation: Implement non-chemical water treatment (e.g. electrochemical or ultrasonic) to increase cooling tower cycles of concentration to 7+ cycles.

description: At least 50% of landscape irrigation must be supplied by non-potable sources such as rainwater harvesting or recycled AHU condensate.
actionable_recommendation: Divert AHU condensate drain lines and roof storm runoff to a 50m3 non-potable underground retention tank for drip irrigation.

description: Commercial lodging spaces must replace at least 15% of total water demand with harvested rainwater or treated greywater for toilet flushing.
actionable_recommendation: Implement a dual-pipe plumbing distribution network utilizing UV-treated greywater for podium and basement toilet flushing.
